provenance.authoring_note: The approved local corpus and pinned analyzer establish bounded candidate evidence only. Each admitted lexical identity, POS correction, gloss, and single-sense decision is separately authored. Diagnostic sentence frames are Typewriter-authored and are not corpus excerpts or measured writer outcomes. Empty relation lists are valid; no admission quota is applied.

review.method: Separately verify source-bound identity, POS, current surface ownership, concise Typewriter-authored gloss, and a fresh one-sense boundary review in two diagnostic frames; then apply the shared semantic admission contract. Writer-use notes and routes are enrichment metadata. Corpus counts set review order only.
criteria: exact source-bound observed candidate and POS; corrected analyzer POS requires two bounded-context identifiers
no canonical lemma, curated search-form, or generated-surface collision
bounded in-scope lexical meaning and complete single-sense boundary review
Typewriter-authored gloss; diagnostic frames are not corpus evidence
zero relations when no candidate-specific relation is separately supported
no admission by corpus frequency, usefulness, generality, vividness, or relation count

coverage_basis: source-bound Typewriter lexical identity after independent semantic eligibility
selection.selection_rationale: All separately reviewed admitted lexical identities enter ordinary shared admission. The 20-row review limit and corpus order do not set an admission quota; unresolved rows remain held.
